Title: Application discovery with Server Assessment in Azure Migrate is now in preview

Body.Content:
Discover installed applications, roles, and features with the Server Assessment tool in Azure Migrate. The capability is now available in preview for VMware servers.

To export the application inventory, go to Server Assessment in the Azure portal.

Learn how to prepare for application discovery.
